text: Develop ideas or material for columns or commentaries by analyzing and interpreting news, current issues, or personal experiences.
Develop sales presentations or proposals to explain service specifications.
Perform routine maintenance on wind turbine equipment, underground transmission systems, wind fields substations, or fiber optic sensing and control systems.
Perform quality control checks on laboratory equipment or cameras.
Report results of statistical analyses, including information in the form of graphs, charts, and tables.
Identify potential for loss and develop strategies to eliminate it.
Confer with the board of directors to formulate and interpret policies, to determine budget requirements, and to plan overall operations.
Confer with customers to determine project requirements or to provide cost estimates.

Recommend strategies for clients to meet their financial goals, such as borrowing money through loans or loan programs, declaring bankruptcy, making budget adjustments, or enrolling in debt management plans.

Supervise, coordinate, or schedule the activities of construction or extractive workers.
Fill out required job or shift report forms.
Perform safety checks on equipment before operating.

Remove items from washers or dry-cleaning machines, or direct other workers to do so.
